urdu: کس پیشرفت نے انسانی تہذیب کی ترقی میں ثقافت کی حوصلہ افزائی کی؟
english: Which advancement encouraged the development of culture in human civilization?
roman_1: Kis peshraft ne insani tehzeeb ki taraqqi mein saqafat ki hosla afzai ki?
roman_2: Kis peshraft nay insani tehzeeb ki taraqqi main sakafat ki hosla afzai ki?
roman_3: Kis peshraft nay insani tehzeeb ki tarakki mein saqafat ki hosla afzai ki?
